notes: NBG (ibank) account movements Excel (.xlsx, also .xls), read by nbg-ynab-export with pandas defaults, so the header is row 1 with no rows above: 28 Greek columns from "Α/Α Συναλλαγής" to "Χρεωστική Κάρτα", among them Ημερομηνία, Ώρα, Valeur, Ποσό συναλλαγής, Χρέωση / Πίστωση, Περιγραφή, Λογιστικό Υπόλοιπο. Cells are TEXT as in the importer's fixture: dates dd/mm/yyyy, amounts signed with a decimal comma and no thousands mark ("-650,00", "1410,25"), the running balance likewise; Χρέωση / Πίστωση spells the direction; Νόμισμα/Ισοτιμία are filled only for foreign-currency orders; newest first. "Aγορά" starts with a Latin A as in the fixture. The sheet name is not documented.
